digest.component_or_area: push non-fast-forward recovery / git store merge handling
propositions: _recover_dirty_merge fails on untracked-file collisions during merge (untracked files deliberately left after git reset --hard conflict with remote merge intent), aborting and restoring stash without self-healing
untracked-overwrite collisions from compaction artifacts (*-SNAPSHOT.json, *.retired) wedge push recovery exactly as they wedge reconverge, with no recovery path in push_recovery.py

merge aborts on untracked-overwrite can be recovered by parsing git merge-abort output for collision paths, quarantining named untracked files to <git-common-dir>/reconverge-quarantine/<utc-ts>/, and retrying merge once
stash commit object must be restored exactly once on all exit paths (success, retry-failure, non-recoverable abort) to preserve tracked edits across recovery
genuine conflicts and unnamed collision paths must preserve today's abort-restore-warn behavior unchanged; quarantine parser and mover must be reused from sync module to avoid duplication
